hooks.text: 躲狙击精准弹与Boss红色激光的3D弹幕枪战
hooks.excerpt: Avoid fast and precise shots from snipers, dash thru waves of red lasers from bosses. Every enemy has different attack patterns keeping you on your toes.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 英雄以左轮、电索、闪光弹或狙击套组形成差异打法
hooks.excerpt: Master Calix's close-range revolver, electrify multiple foes with the Electro Lasso, and blind enemies with the Flash Bang for an aggressive approach. Wield Keri's long-range marksman rifle, amplify shots with the Electro Screen, and unleash devastation from afar with the Bowling Bomb.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每局随机生成perk进度网格塑造独特构筑
hooks.excerpt: Enhance your abilities, upgrade your weapon and amass perks to create powerful and unique builds for each playthrough. The progression grid randomly generates with different perks in every run, adding an exciting layer of replayability.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
